notes: The daily gold/silver fix is set by FENEGOSIDA and published on its own site; the fix embeds customs duty and taxes. The duty %, VAT exemption and making % previously cited came from guide and news pages and were removed in review round 1 pending a primary tariff/VAT page. No bar-by-size list or buyback % published.

sources.name: FENEGOSIDA - Federation of Nepal Gold and Silver Dealers' Association (official site)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the federation's own site publishes its official daily gold and silver fix (per tola and per 10g); the fix is the market rate for Nepal.
